team</a></li></ul></div></nav><div class="prose prose--block prose--blog col-span-full!"><p>Cursor is used by tens of thousands of enterprises, including Salesforce, NVIDIA, and PwC, to accelerate product velocity and build durable software.</p>
<p>To further support enterprise teams, we’re launching new features that make Cursor’s coding agents more capable, transparent, and secure.</p>
<figure class="!my-1"><div style="aspect-ratio:1920 / 1080;overflow:hidden"><div class="media-border-container media-controller w-full " style="width:100%;height:100%;background-color:var(--theme-bg-sec, #1a1a1a)"></div></div></figure>
<h3 id="hooks" class="anchor-heading group "><a href="#hooks" class="anchor-link" aria-label="Link to this section"><span class="anchor-icon" aria-hidden="true">#</span></a>Hooks</h3>
<p><a href="https://cursor.com/docs/hooks" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Hooks</a> allow you observe, control, and extend the agent loop using custom scripts.</p>
<div class="prose-code-block"><pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark" style="background-color:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e;color:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">{</span></span>

<div class="card mb-v2"><blockquote class="not-prose"><p class="type-base whitespace-pre-wrap">Integrating Cursor Hooks with our engineering intelligence platform gives us a better sense of how AI is affecting developer productivity throughout the software development lifecycle, and gives engineering leaders the insights they need to make smarter decisions.</p></blockquote><div class="mt-v1 flex items-center space-x-(--grid-gap)"><div class="avatar-border-container h-[2.5rem] w-[2.5rem] shrink-0"><img alt="Rebecca Fitzhugh" loading="lazy" width="42" height="42" decoding="async" data-nimg="1" class="h-full w-full object-cover" style="color:transparent" srcSet="/marketing-static/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fptht05hbb1ssoooe.public.blob.vercel-storage.com%2Fassets%2Favatars%2Frebecca-fitzhugh-avatar.jpg&amp;w=48&amp;q=70 1x, /marketing-static/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fptht05hbb1ssoooe.public.blob.vercel-storage.com%2Fassets%2Favatars%2Frebecca-fitzhugh-avatar.jpg&amp;w=96&amp;q=70 2x" src="/marketing-static/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fptht05hbb1ssoooe.public.blob.vercel-storage.com%2Fassets%2Favatars%2Frebecca-fitzhugh-avatar.jpg&amp;w=96&amp;q=70"/></div><div><div class="type-sm">Rebecca Fitzhugh</div><div class="type-sm text-theme-text-sec">Lead Principal Engineer<!-- -->, <!-- -->Atlassian</div></div></div></div>
<p>Hooks can:</p>
<ol>
<li>
<p><strong>Add observability:</strong> Log agent actions, tool calls, prompts, and completions for future analysis.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Control the full agent loop:</strong> Enforce compliance policies, block unapproved commands, and scrub secrets or proprietary code in real time.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Extend Cursor with code:</strong> Connect external systems, inject context, or trigger automations.</p>
</li>
</ol>
<p>Hooks can be distributed through MDM or with <a href="https://cursor.com/docs/hooks#cloud-distribution-enterprise-only" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Cursor’s cloud option</a>.</p>
<h3 id="team-rules" class="anchor-heading group "><a href="#team-rules" class="anchor-link" aria-label="Link to this section"><span class="anchor-icon" aria-hidden="true">#</span></a>Team Rules</h3>
<p><a href="https://cursor.com/docs/rules#team-rules" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Team Rules</a> bring shared context and best practices to every developer in your organization.</p>
<figure><div class="media-border-container overflow-hidden"><img alt="" loading="lazy" width="800" height="450" decoding="async" data-nimg="1" class="transition-opacity duration-[220ms] ease-[var(--ease-out-spring)] will-change-[opacity] opacity-0" style="color:transparent" srcSet="/marketing-static/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fptht05hbb1ssoooe.public.blob.vercel-storage.com%2Fassets%2Fblog%2Fenterprise-0.png&amp;w=828&amp;q=70 1x, /marketing-static/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fptht05hbb1ssoooe.public.blob.vercel-storage.com%2Fassets%2Fblog%2Fenterprise-0.png&amp;w=1920&amp;q=70 2x" src="/marketing-static/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fptht05hbb1ssoooe.public.blob.vercel-storage.com%2Fassets%2Fblog%2Fenterprise-0.png&amp;w=1920&amp;q=70"/></div></figure>
<div class="card mb-v2"><blockquote class="not-prose"><p class="type-base whitespace-pre-wrap">Team Rules make it easy for our agents to stay aligned with how we build at Duolingo. They guide developers toward the right patterns automatically, so we spend less time fixing and more time shipping.</p></blockquote><div class="mt-v1 flex items-center space-x-(--grid-gap)"><div class="avatar-border-container h-[2.5rem] w-[2.5rem] shrink-0"><img alt="Sarah Deitke" loading="lazy" width="42" height="42" decoding="async" data-nimg="1" class="h-full w-full object-cover" style="color:transparent" srcSet="/marketing-static/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fptht05hbb1ssoooe.public.blob.vercel-storage.com%2Fassets%2Favatars%2Fsarah-deitke-avatar.jpg&amp;w=48&amp;q=70 1x, /marketing-static/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fptht05hbb1ssoooe.public.blob.vercel-storage.com%2Fassets%2Favatars%2Fsarah-deitke-avatar.jpg&amp;w=96&amp;q=70 2x" src="/marketing-static/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fptht05hbb1ssoooe.public.blob.vercel-storage.com%2Fassets%2Favatars%2Fsarah-deitke-avatar.jpg&amp;w=96&amp;q=70"/></div><div><div class="type-sm">Sarah Deitke</div><div class="type-sm text-theme-text-sec">Software Engineer<!-- -->, <!-- -->Duolingo</div></div></div></div>
<p>Rules can standardize API schemas, enforce conventions, or teach common workflows. Admins can choose to recommend or require rules from the <a href="https://cursor.com/dashboard/team-content" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">cloud dashboard</a>.</p>
<h3 id="upgraded-analytics" class="anchor-heading group "><a href="#upgraded-analytics" class="anchor-link" aria-label="Link to this section"><span class="anchor-icon" aria-hidden="true">#</span></a>Upgraded Analytics</h3>
<p>We’ve <a href="https://cursor.com/docs/account/teams/analytics" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">rebuilt our analytics</a> to give leaders data about how their teams use AI:</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>See daily activity and top users at a glance</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Data on CLI, Background Agent, and Bugbot adoption</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>View percentage of AI lines of code on the commit level</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Filter data by Active Directory group</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Exportable replication data per visualization (via API or CSV)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Data updates every two minutes instead of every 24 hours</p>
</li>
</ul>
<figure><div class="media-border-container overflow-hidden"><img alt="" loading="lazy" width="800" height="450" decoding="async" data-nimg="1" class="transition-opacity duration-[220ms] ease-[var(--ease-out-spring)] will-change-[opacity] opacity-0" style="color:transparent" srcSet="/marketing-static/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fptht05hbb1ssoooe.public.blob.vercel-storage.com%2Fassets%2Fblog%2Fenterprise-1.png&amp;w=828&amp;q=70 1x, /marketing-static/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fptht05hbb1ssoooe.public.blob.vercel-storage.com%2Fassets%2Fblog%2Fenterprise-1.png&amp;w=1920&amp;q=70 2x" src="/marketing-static/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fptht05hbb1ssoooe.public.blob.vercel-storage.com%2Fassets%2Fblog%2Fenterprise-1.png&amp;w=1920&amp;q=70"/></div></figure>
<div class="card mb-v2"><blockquote class="not-prose"><p class="type-base whitespace-pre-wrap">The new usage leaderboard has already helped us surface power users and learn how they work. The cleaner dashboard makes the data easier to trust and act on.</p></blockquote><div class="mt-v1 flex items-center space-x-(--grid-gap)"><div class="avatar-border-container h-[2.5rem] w-[2.5rem] shrink-0"><img alt="Nicolas Arkhipenko" loading="lazy" width="42" height="42" decoding="async" data-nimg="1" class="h-full w-full object-cover" style="color:transparent" srcSet="/marketing-static/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fptht05hbb1ssoooe.public.blob.vercel-storage.com%2Fassets%2Favatars%2Fnicolas-arkhipenko-avatar.jpg&amp;w=48&amp;q=70 1x, /marketing-static/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fptht05hbb1ssoooe.public.blob.vercel-storage.com%2Fassets%2Favatars%2Fnicolas-arkhipenko-avatar.jpg&amp;w=96&amp;q=70 2x" src="/marketing-static/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fptht05hbb1ssoooe.public.blob.vercel-storage.com%2Fassets%2Favatars%2Fnicolas-arkhipenko-avatar.jpg&amp;w=96&amp;q=70"/></div><div><div class="type-sm">Nicolas Arkhipenko</div><div class="type-sm text-theme-text-sec">Senior Director of AI Platforms &amp; Developer Productivity<!-- -->, <!-- -->Salesforce</div></div></div></div>
<p>The upgraded dashboard is generally available today, with data from August 27th for all clients 1.7 and later.</p>
<h3 id="audit-log" class="anchor-heading group "><a href="#audit-log" class="anchor-link" aria-label="Link to this section"><span class="anchor-icon" aria-hidden="true">#</span></a>Audit Log</h3>
<p><a href="https://cursor.com/docs/account/teams/dashboard#audit-log" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Audit Log</a> gives administrators full visibility into every key event on the platform from security changes to rule updates.</p>
<p>It currently tracks 19 event types covering access, asset edits, and configuration updates.</p>
<figure><div class="media-border-container overflow-hidden"><img alt="" loading="lazy" width="800" height="450" decoding="async" data-nimg="1" class="transition-opacity duration-[220ms] ease-[var(--ease-out-spring)] will-change-[opacity] opacity-0" style="color:transparent" srcSet="/marketing-static/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fptht05hbb1ssoooe.public.blob.vercel-storage.com%2Fassets%2Fblog%2Fenterprise-2.png&amp;w=828&amp;q=70 1x, /marketing-static/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fptht05hbb1ssoooe.public.blob.vercel-storage.com%2Fassets%2Fblog%2Fenterprise-2.png&amp;w=1920&amp;q=70 2x" src="/marketing-static/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fptht05hbb1ssoooe.public.blob.vercel-storage.com%2Fassets%2Fblog%2Fenterprise-2.png&amp;w=1920&amp;q=70"/></div></figure>
<p>Audit Log data is available in the web dashboard and can be exported as a CSV.</p>
<h3 id="sandbox-mode" class="anchor-heading group "><a href="#sandbox-mode" class="anchor-link" aria-label="Link to this section"><span class="anchor-icon" aria-hidden="true">#</span></a>Sandbox Mode</h3>
<p><a href="https://cursor.com/docs/agent/tools/terminal" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Sandbox Mode</a> executes agent terminal commands in a restricted environment to enable faster and safer iteration.</p>
<p>By default, the sandbox blocks network access, limiting file access to the workspace and <code>/tmp/</code>.</p>
<figure class="!my-1"><div style="aspect-ratio:2716 / 2160;overflow:hidden"><div class="media-border-container media-controller w-full " style="width:100%;height:100%;background-color:var(--theme-bg-sec, #1a1a1a)"></div></div></figure>
<p>If a command fails due to restrictions, the user can skip it or choose to re-run outside the sandbox.</p>
<p>Enterprise Admins have <a href="https://cursor.com/docs/agent/security/run-modes#team-controls" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">control</a> over sandbox availability and team-wide git and network access.</p>
<h3 id="working-with-our-team" class="anchor-heading group "><a href="#working-with-our-team" class="anchor-link" aria-label="Link to this section"><span class="anchor-icon" aria-hidden="true">#</span></a>Working with our team</h3>
<p>We want to make Cursor the best place for teams building with AI. Many of these features were inspired by the work we&#x27;re already doing with many of the most innovative companies in the world, and we’d like to <a href="https://cursor.com/contact-sales?source=enterprise-blog" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">build with yours</a>.</p></div><footer class="mt-v2"><p class="type-base"><span class="text-theme-text-sec">Filed under:<!-- --> </span><a class="text-theme-text hover:text-theme-text/75 active:text-theme-text capitalize" href="/blog/topic/product">product</a></p><p team</a></li></ul></div></nav><div class="prose prose--block prose--blog col-span-full!"><p>Cursor is used by tens of thousands of enterprises, including Salesforce, NVIDIA, and PwC, to accelerate product velocity and build durable software.</p>
<p>To further support enterprise teams, we’re launching new features that make Cursor’s coding agents more capable, transparent, and secure.</p>
<figure class="!my-1"><div style="aspect-ratio:1920 / 1080;overflow:hidden"><div class="media-border-container media-controller w-full " style="width:100%;height:100%;background-color:var(--theme-bg-sec, #1a1a1a)"></div></div></figure>
<h3 id="hooks" class="anchor-heading group "><a href="#hooks" class="anchor-link" aria-label="Link to this section"><span class="anchor-icon" aria-hidden="true">#</span></a>Hooks</h3>
<p><a href="https://cursor.com/docs/hooks" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Hooks</a> allow you observe, control, and extend the agent loop using custom scripts.</p>
<div class="prose-code-block"><pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark" style="background-color:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e;color:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">{</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">  &quot;hooks&quot;</span><span style="color:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">: {</span></span>

<div class="card mb-v2"><blockquote class="not-prose"><p class="type-base whitespace-pre-wrap">Integrating Cursor Hooks with our engineering intelligence platform gives us a better sense of how AI is affecting developer productivity throughout the software development lifecycle, and gives engineering leaders the insights they need to make smarter decisions.</p></blockquote><div class="mt-v1 flex items-center space-x-(--grid-gap)"><div class="avatar-border-container h-[2.5rem] w-[2.5rem] shrink-0"><img alt="Rebecca Fitzhugh" loading="lazy" width="42" height="42" decoding="async" data-nimg="1" class="h-full w-full object-cover" style="color:transparent" srcSet="/marketing-static/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fptht05hbb1ssoooe.public.blob.vercel-storage.com%2Fassets%2Favatars%2Frebecca-fitzhugh-avatar.jpg&amp;w=48&amp;q=70 1x, /marketing-static/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fptht05hbb1ssoooe.public.blob.vercel-storage.com%2Fassets%2Favatars%2Frebecca-fitzhugh-avatar.jpg&amp;w=96&amp;q=70 2x" src="/marketing-static/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fptht05hbb1ssoooe.public.blob.vercel-storage.com%2Fassets%2Favatars%2Frebecca-fitzhugh-avatar.jpg&amp;w=96&amp;q=70"/></div><div><div class="type-sm">Rebecca Fitzhugh</div><div class="type-sm text-theme-text-sec">Lead Principal Engineer<!-- -->, <!-- -->Atlassian</div></div></div></div>
<p>Hooks can:</p>
<ol>
<li>
<p><strong>Add observability:</strong> Log agent actions, tool calls, prompts, and completions for future analysis.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Control the full agent loop:</strong> Enforce compliance policies, block unapproved commands, and scrub secrets or proprietary code in real time.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Extend Cursor with code:</strong> Connect external systems, inject context, or trigger automations.</p>
</li>
</ol>
<p>Hooks can be distributed through MDM or with <a href="https://cursor.com/docs/hooks#cloud-distribution-enterprise-only" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Cursor’s cloud option</a>.</p>
<h3 id="team-rules" class="anchor-heading group "><a href="#team-rules" class="anchor-link" aria-label="Link to this section"><span class="anchor-icon" aria-hidden="true">#</span></a>Team Rules</h3>
<p><a href="https://cursor.com/docs/rules#team-rules" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Team Rules</a> bring shared context and best practices to every developer in your organization.</p>
<figure><div class="media-border-container overflow-hidden"><img alt="" loading="lazy" width="800" height="450" decoding="async" data-nimg="1" class="transition-opacity duration-[220ms] ease-[var(--ease-out-spring)] will-change-[opacity] opacity-0" style="color:transparent" srcSet="/marketing-static/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fptht05hbb1ssoooe.public.blob.vercel-storage.com%2Fassets%2Fblog%2Fenterprise-0.png&amp;w=828&amp;q=70 1x, /marketing-static/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fptht05hbb1ssoooe.public.blob.vercel-storage.com%2Fassets%2Fblog%2Fenterprise-0.png&amp;w=1920&amp;q=70 2x" src="/marketing-static/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fptht05hbb1ssoooe.public.blob.vercel-storage.com%2Fassets%2Fblog%2Fenterprise-0.png&amp;w=1920&amp;q=70"/></div></figure>
<div class="card mb-v2"><blockquote class="not-prose"><p class="type-base whitespace-pre-wrap">Team Rules make it easy for our agents to stay aligned with how we build at Duolingo. They guide developers toward the right patterns automatically, so we spend less time fixing and more time shipping.</p></blockquote><div class="mt-v1 flex items-center space-x-(--grid-gap)"><div class="avatar-border-container h-[2.5rem] w-[2.5rem] shrink-0"><img alt="Sarah Deitke" loading="lazy" width="42" height="42" decoding="async" data-nimg="1" class="h-full w-full object-cover" style="color:transparent" srcSet="/marketing-static/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fptht05hbb1ssoooe.public.blob.vercel-storage.com%2Fassets%2Favatars%2Fsarah-deitke-avatar.jpg&amp;w=48&amp;q=70 1x, /marketing-static/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fptht05hbb1ssoooe.public.blob.vercel-storage.com%2Fassets%2Favatars%2Fsarah-deitke-avatar.jpg&amp;w=96&amp;q=70 2x" src="/marketing-static/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fptht05hbb1ssoooe.public.blob.vercel-storage.com%2Fassets%2Favatars%2Fsarah-deitke-avatar.jpg&amp;w=96&amp;q=70"/></div><div><div class="type-sm">Sarah Deitke</div><div class="type-sm text-theme-text-sec">Software Engineer<!-- -->, <!-- -->Duolingo</div></div></div></div>
<p>Rules can standardize API schemas, enforce conventions, or teach common workflows. Admins can choose to recommend or require rules from the <a href="https://cursor.com/dashboard/team-content" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">cloud dashboard</a>.</p>
<h3 id="upgraded-analytics" class="anchor-heading group "><a href="#upgraded-analytics" class="anchor-link" aria-label="Link to this section"><span class="anchor-icon" aria-hidden="true">#</span></a>Upgraded Analytics</h3>
<p>We’ve <a href="https://cursor.com/docs/account/teams/analytics" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">rebuilt our analytics</a> to give leaders data about how their teams use AI:</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>See daily activity and top users at a glance</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Data on CLI, Background Agent, and Bugbot adoption</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>View percentage of AI lines of code on the commit level</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Filter data by Active Directory group</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Exportable replication data per visualization (via API or CSV)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Data updates every two minutes instead of every 24 hours</p>
</li>
</ul>
<figure><div class="media-border-container overflow-hidden"><img alt="" loading="lazy" width="800" height="450" decoding="async" data-nimg="1" class="transition-opacity duration-[220ms] ease-[var(--ease-out-spring)] will-change-[opacity] opacity-0" style="color:transparent" srcSet="/marketing-static/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fptht05hbb1ssoooe.public.blob.vercel-storage.com%2Fassets%2Fblog%2Fenterprise-1.png&amp;w=828&amp;q=70 1x, /marketing-static/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fptht05hbb1ssoooe.public.blob.vercel-storage.com%2Fassets%2Fblog%2Fenterprise-1.png&amp;w=1920&amp;q=70 2x" src="/marketing-static/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fptht05hbb1ssoooe.public.blob.vercel-storage.com%2Fassets%2Fblog%2Fenterprise-1.png&amp;w=1920&amp;q=70"/></div></figure>
<div class="card mb-v2"><blockquote class="not-prose"><p class="type-base whitespace-pre-wrap">The new usage leaderboard has already helped us surface power users and learn how they work. The cleaner dashboard makes the data easier to trust and act on.</p></blockquote><div class="mt-v1 flex items-center space-x-(--grid-gap)"><div class="avatar-border-container h-[2.5rem] w-[2.5rem] shrink-0"><img alt="Nicolas Arkhipenko" loading="lazy" width="42" height="42" decoding="async" data-nimg="1" class="h-full w-full object-cover" style="color:transparent" srcSet="/marketing-static/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fptht05hbb1ssoooe.public.blob.vercel-storage.com%2Fassets%2Favatars%2Fnicolas-arkhipenko-avatar.jpg&amp;w=48&amp;q=70 1x, /marketing-static/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fptht05hbb1ssoooe.public.blob.vercel-storage.com%2Fassets%2Favatars%2Fnicolas-arkhipenko-avatar.jpg&amp;w=96&amp;q=70 2x" src="/marketing-static/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fptht05hbb1ssoooe.public.blob.vercel-storage.com%2Fassets%2Favatars%2Fnicolas-arkhipenko-avatar.jpg&amp;w=96&amp;q=70"/></div><div><div class="type-sm">Nicolas Arkhipenko</div><div class="type-sm text-theme-text-sec">Senior Director of AI Platforms &amp; Developer Productivity<!-- -->, <!-- -->Salesforce</div></div></div></div>
<p>The upgraded dashboard is generally available today, with data from August 27th for all clients 1.7 and later.</p>
<h3 id="audit-log" class="anchor-heading group "><a href="#audit-log" class="anchor-link" aria-label="Link to this section"><span class="anchor-icon" aria-hidden="true">#</span></a>Audit Log</h3>
<p><a href="https://cursor.com/docs/account/teams/dashboard#audit-log" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Audit Log</a> gives administrators full visibility into every key event on the platform from security changes to rule updates.</p>
<p>It currently tracks 19 event types covering access, asset edits, and configuration updates.</p>
<figure><div class="media-border-container overflow-hidden"><img alt="" loading="lazy" width="800" height="450" decoding="async" data-nimg="1" class="transition-opacity duration-[220ms] ease-[var(--ease-out-spring)] will-change-[opacity] opacity-0" style="color:transparent" srcSet="/marketing-static/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fptht05hbb1ssoooe.public.blob.vercel-storage.com%2Fassets%2Fblog%2Fenterprise-2.png&amp;w=828&amp;q=70 1x, /marketing-static/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fptht05hbb1ssoooe.public.blob.vercel-storage.com%2Fassets%2Fblog%2Fenterprise-2.png&amp;w=1920&amp;q=70 2x" src="/marketing-static/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fptht05hbb1ssoooe.public.blob.vercel-storage.com%2Fassets%2Fblog%2Fenterprise-2.png&amp;w=1920&amp;q=70"/></div></figure>
<p>Audit Log data is available in the web dashboard and can be exported as a CSV.</p>
<h3 id="sandbox-mode" class="anchor-heading group "><a href="#sandbox-mode" class="anchor-link" aria-label="Link to this section"><span class="anchor-icon" aria-hidden="true">#</span></a>Sandbox Mode</h3>
<p><a href="https://cursor.com/docs/agent/tools/terminal" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Sandbox Mode</a> executes agent terminal commands in a restricted environment to enable faster and safer iteration.</p>
<p>By default, the sandbox blocks network access, limiting file access to the workspace and <code>/tmp/</code>.</p>
<figure class="!my-1"><div style="aspect-ratio:2716 / 2160;overflow:hidden"><div class="media-border-container media-controller w-full " style="width:100%;height:100%;background-color:var(--theme-bg-sec, #1a1a1a)"></div></div></figure>
<p>If a command fails due to restrictions, the user can skip it or choose to re-run outside the sandbox.</p>
<p>Enterprise Admins have <a href="https://cursor.com/docs/agent/security/run-modes#team-controls" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">control</a> over sandbox availability and team-wide git and network access.</p>
<h3 id="working-with-our-team" class="anchor-heading group "><a href="#working-with-our-team" class="anchor-link" aria-label="Link to this section"><span class="anchor-icon" aria-hidden="true">#</span></a>Working with our team</h3>
<p>We want to make Cursor the best place for teams building with AI. Many of these features were inspired by the work we&#x27;re already doing with many of the most innovative companies in the world, and we’d like to <a href="https://cursor.com/contact-sales?source=enterprise-blog" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">build with yours</a>.</p></div><footer class="mt-v2"><p class="type-base"><span
